home.hero: Learn graph intelligence and observability by doing

sections.readyCalloutBody: Choose an experiment and inspect the guided workflow.

experiments.title: Experiments

experiments.failedToLoad: Failed to load experiments. Check the backend connection.
experiments.inputsHint: Provide the inputs for the operation (e.g., dataset_id, fixture_key, source, target). Comma-separated key:value pairs.
experiments.servicesNotConfigured: Grafana/Tempo not configured in this environment. trace_id is populated; the deep-link will be available after G07 deployment.

workbench.executionDisabledBody: Connect this control to the existing run API and validators.
workbench.challengeHint: Solve the task without step-by-step hints.

graph.title: Graph Explorer

observability.servicesUnavailable: Telemetry services are unavailable in this environment.
observability.servicesUnavailableBody: Prometheus, Tempo, and Grafana probes must succeed before any metrics or traces are shown here. The backend exposes /api/v1/health/ready — when those services report 'ready', this page populates automatically.
